run_interactive_translation: run the fairseq interactive CLI to translate raw text with a trained model
run_buffered_read: run buffered_read to read input lines in fixed-size buffer chunks from a file
run_make_batches: run make_batches to create inference batches from input lines with optional constraints
run_main: run main to load a model ensemble and perform interactive translation inference
run_cli_main: run cli_main to parse CLI args and start the interactive translation tool
